steps.en: Install Serve into the Python environment that reaches your Ray cluster
steps.zh: 在能连上 Ray 集群的 Python 环境里装上 Serve

steps.en: Wrap each model in a class and declare its replicas and CPU/GPU needs
steps.zh: 把每个模型包成一个类，声明副本数和 CPU/GPU 需求

steps.en: Bind the models into one app, passing downstream models into the ingress
steps.zh: 把模型绑成一个应用，下游模型作为参数传给入口部署

steps.en: Run the application on the cluster
Starts each deployment's replicas as Ray actors on nodes with the right resources
steps.zh: 把每个部署的副本作为 Ray actor 起在资源合适的节点上

steps.en: Takes HTTP on :8000, load-balances to the ingress, which calls the other models
steps.zh: 在 :8000 收 HTTP，均衡分给入口部署，入口再调其他模型

steps.en: Adds or removes replicas per deployment as its own traffic changes
steps.zh: 按各部署自己的流量增减副本

value.en: Several models sit behind one endpoint and each scales on its own — no per-model service and scaling script
value.zh: 多个模型挂在同一个入口后面、各自扩缩，不用每个模型一套服务和扩容脚本

sources: https://github.com/ray-project/ray/blob/master/doc/source/serve/getting_started.md (pip install "ray[serve]", serve run serve_quickstart_composed:app, http://127.0.0.1:8000/, autoscaling_config / num_replicas / num_gpus per deployment)
https://github.com/ray-project/ray/blob/master/doc/source/serve/key-concepts.md (@serve.deployment, .bind(), replicas as Ray actors, ingress deployment, DeploymentHandle)
https://github.com/ray-project/ray/blob/master/doc/source/serve/architecture.md (Controller actor manages replicas; HTTP Proxy actor on the head node by default)
